mapper.insert: insert into attach( attach_no, attach_name, attach_type, attach_size, attach_uploader, attach_source ) values( #{attachNo}, #{attachName}, #{attachType}, #{attachSize}, #{attachUploader}, #{attachSource} )

insert into attach( attach_no, attach_name, attach_type, attach_size, attach_uploader, attach_source, attach_source_no ) values( #{attachNo}, #{attachName}, #{attachType}, #{attachSize}, #{attachUploader}, #{attachSource}, #{attachSourceNo} )
mapper.select: select attach_no, attach_name, attach_type, attach_size, attach_uploader, attach_source, attach_source_no, attach_ctime from attach where attach_no = #{attachNo}

select a.attach_no, a.attach_name, a.attach_type, a.attach_size, a.attach_uploader, a.attach_source, a.attach_source_no, a.attach_ctime, e.emp_name as empName from project_file pf join attach a on pf.attach_no = a.attach_no left join emp e on a.attach_uploader = e.emp_no where pf.project_no = #{projectNo} order by a.attach_ctime desc

select a.attach_no, a.attach_name, a.attach_type, a.attach_size, a.attach_uploader, a.attach_source, a.attach_source_no, a.attach_ctime, e.emp_name as empName from project_file pf join attach a on pf.attach_no = a.attach_no left join emp e on a.attach_uploader = e.emp_no where pf.project_no = #{projectNo} and a.attach_name like '%' || #{keyword} || '%' order by a.attach_ctime desc
